articles.title: Golconda Gold Releases Q3 2026 Production Update at Galaxy
articles.description: TORONTO, Oct. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Golconda Gold Ltd. ("Golconda Gold” or the "Company”) (TSX-V: GG; OTCQX: GGGOF) is pleased to announce record quarterly production of 4,301 ounces of gold for the third quarter of 2026 ("Q3 2026”) at its Galaxy Gold Mine ("Galaxy”), an increase of 18% in gold production compared to Q2 2026 and an increase of 20% compared to Q3 2025. The Q3 2026 production numbers are as follows: Mining Q3 2026 Q2 YTD FY 2025 Q3 PrincetonOre Mined(t) 19,17814,11051,24159,42822,303Ore Grade(g/t)3.813.753.653.883.39Development(m)292244809952272GalaxyOre Mined(t)29,65526,04981,79376,00018,200Ore Grade(g/t)3.082.562.813.133.22Development(m)27214354337182TotalOre Mined(t)48,83340,159133,034135,42840,503Ore Grade(g/t)3.362.983.143.463.31Development(m)5643871,3521,323354Processing Q3 Ore processed(t)49,16644,811135,156130,63737,163Concentrate produced(t)3,8983,60211,87211,2893,229Concentrate grade(g/t)34.331.530.435.934.6Gold produced(oz)4,3013,64811,58613,0203,588 Golconda Gold CEO, Ravi Sood commented: "We are pleased to announce record quarterly gold production at Galaxy for Q3 2026, including record ore tonnes mined, processed and development metres. Our recent investment in underground mining equipment and surface infrastructure has significantly increased equipment availability and mining cycle efficiency, and we expect further operational improvements going forward in the final quarter of 2026.” (1) About Golconda Gold Golconda Gold is an un-hedged gold producer and explorer with mining operations and exploration tenements in South Africa and New Mexico. The Q3 2026 production numbers are as follows: Mining Q3 2026 Q2 YTD FY 2025 Q3 PrincetonOre Mined(t) 19,17814,11051,24159,42822,303Ore Grade(g/t)3.813.753.653.883.39Development(m)292244809952272GalaxyOre Mined(t)29,65526,04981,79376,00018,200Ore Grade(g/t)3.082.562.813.133.22Development(m)27214354337182TotalOre Mined(t)48,83340,159133,034135,42840,503Ore Grade(g/t)3.362.983.143.463.31Development(m)5643871,3521,323354Processing Q3 Ore processed(t)49,16644,811135,156130,63737,163Concentrate produced(t)3,8983,60211,87211,2893,229Concentrate grade(g/t)34.331.530.435.934.6Gold produced(oz)4,3013,64811,58613,0203,588 Golconda Gold CEO, Ravi Sood commented: "We are pleased to announce record quarterly gold production at Galaxy for Q3 2026, including record ore tonnes mined, processed and development metres. Our recent investment in underground mining equipment and surface infrastructure has significantly increased equipment availability and mining cycle efficiency, and we expect further operational improvements going forward in the final quarter of 2026.” (1) About Golconda Gold Golconda Gold is an un-hedged gold producer and explorer with mining operations and exploration tenements in South Africa and New Mexico. Golconda Gold is a public company and its shares are quoted on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol "GG” and the OTCQX under the symbol "GGGOF”. Golconda Gold’s management team is comprised of senior mining professionals with extensive experience in managing mining and processing operations and large-scale exploration programmes. Golconda Gold is committed to operating at the highest standards, focused on the safety of its employees, respecting the environment, and contributing to the communities in which it operates.
